artifacts.summary: Seven-phase, 10-hour plan relocating the full gate battery's ownership to the orchestration close: vocabulary amendment, red-close per-task record and status binding, interrupted-invocation obligation, and consumer-repository closing-gate consumption.

memory_candidates.content: A plan that edits any context/**, rules/**, or agents/** markdown file in the agent-system source store moves a line_count that agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json declares, and check-extension-docs.sh Rule R fails on that drift with a hard (not advisory) default gate mode. Every such phase therefore owes index-entries.json as an entry in its own Files to modify block plus an in-phase `generate-context-line-counts.sh --write` reconciliation step -- this is the coupled-generated-surface obligation's most frequently triggered instance in this repository, and it applies to documentation-only phases that look like they have no generated surface at all.
